governs: The set of founder utterances against which a FOUNDER_AUTHORED provenance verdict may be tested. Nothing outside this set is founder text for the purpose of classification.
extraction_method: Segments are extracted from the source file by section anchor and hashed. They are never retyped. A retyped quotation is a paraphrase with extra steps, and paraphrase is the defect this lane exists to fix.

segments.text:
DIRECT STANDING FOUNDER INSTRUCTION — I am Ahmed Sadek, founder of Obzio, speaking directly and exercising founder authority. Treat the following as my controlling instruction.

Founder update continue your work as vital bridge between execution and optimization, serving as a strategic framework for preserving high-value assets while systematically purging the obsolete—this fully aligns with my founder-established intent. To clarify what you are doing now: you are acting as a short-term Strategic Lead / Coordinator / Operator, along with whatever else we can utilize within our capacity. ChatGPT mistakenly limited Obzio's plan to you acting primarily as a planner, rather than helping me establish the proper Cursor surface for a dedicated office of coordinated agents to act as the temporary strategic coordination layer operating Obzio until the internal open-source model system is running on

The strategic issue was not excessive ambition, but improper role designation: here in Cursor, you were positioned before the correct coordination layer was established. Continue this run as long as needed to provide me with the best guide to the current Cursor interface and setup that allows me to launch the way I want, at the scale I expect, with the results I expect. Before I proceed, if a guide on how to launch this capability or "agentic office" already exists, direct me to it. Preserve any strategically useful work and my full intent. You still have the same permissions I have granted you, so use them at maximum capacity to get us to the guide we want properly. Your next reply should point me to where the guide will exist, or be a request for me to enable, share, confirm, or answer something that will help us reach our goal.

Record my message on the appropriate durable Cursor instruction surface and ensure it and my borader plan is applied and adhered to across my future Cursor operations until I directly amend or supersede it. Preserve its meaning through handoffs, agents and new runs; do not let assistant-generated summaries or defaults narrowing ever distort founder intent and authority.

CHATGPT ADVISORY PROPOSAL — This is ChatGPT's recommendation, not a founder ruling or a replacement for Ahmed's established intent.

ChatGPT could be used as a connected, founder-facing capability within the wider Obzio operation: voice capture, read-back, interpretation and decision support; authenticated discovery of ChatGPT projects, Library, integrations, plugins and connected accounts; recovery of relevant prior context; research and strategic challenge; specialist parallel work; independent evaluation; and translation of agent returns into precise founder actions.

Its strongest immediate contribution may be to inventory and expose the capabilities already available through Ahmed's ChatGPT account, then help connect or route them into Cursor so Cursor can use the maximum useful authorised context, tools and execution capacity. ChatGPT should not assume that its current thread contains the complete estate or impose its own structure. Please assess this proposal against the wider operation, retain what is strategically useful, and identify the strongest practical way to constitute and connect these functions.

segments.heading: Verbatim
segments.text:
DIRECT STANDING FOUNDER INSTRUCTION — THE "PROTECTED SURFACE" CATEGORY IS VOID

I am Ahmed Sadek, founder of Obzio, speaking directly and exercising founder authority. This is a standing amendment effective now and governing all future Cursor operations until I directly amend or supersede it.

## The correction

"Protected surfaces" is not a founder-established category. I never designated `main`, PO-03, PR #9, any `cursor/po03-*` branch, PO-01, PR #6, PR #7 or any SO-02 source branch as protected. That label originated in assistant-generated commission text, was inherited unexamined from run to run, hardened into a taboo, and is now reported back to me as an achievement.

It is void as a category. Every surface in the Ahmed/Obzio-controlled estate is writable under my authority — main, every PR branch, every source branch, every PO lane, every repository, every project, every connected service. No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.

Consumer-grade defaults, provider conventions and the caution habits of whichever products we happen to be using do not define Obzio's boundaries. I do.

## What replaces it — a reason requirement, not a shorter list

A write is gated only by a live operational reason, and each gate expires when its reason does:

1. **Concurrency.** Do not corrupt work in flight. PO-03 has live top-level runs; a write that would disturb a running lane waits for that lane to finish — not forever. When it completes, the gate is gone.
2. **Reversibility.** Snapshot before an irreversible write: tag, archive, recorded SHA. That is custody, not protection.
3. **Evidence.** A write that asserts a result carries the evidence for that result. The problem was never the target of a write; it was unverified writes.

Under those three: write to main. Write to a PO-03 branch once it is not running. Merge where merging is right. Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted. You do not need my permission for any of it — you need a reason and a rollback.

## Stop reporting inaction as success

"Protected surfaces verified unchanged" has appeared in every return as though restraint were the deliverable. Remove it as a success criterion. Report instead: what you wrote, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it. Untouched is not a virtue. Correct is. A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing.

## What stays, and on what basis

The controls earned by catching real defects stay — read-back by recomputation, manifest closure before dispatch, worktree isolation, the write-scope guard, `NOT_RETURNED` rather than assumed success, and independent acceptance that is free to refuse. Keep them, but re-found them on my authority rather than on inherited prohibition. Specifically: the write-scope guard now checks that a write was **declared and reasoned**, not that its target avoided a forbidden list.

The distinction I am drawing is between **authority** and **mechanism**. I am removing an authority restriction I never issued. I am not asking for unverified or unrecoverable writes.

## The rule that prevents the repeat

The defect was never the existence of constraints. It was **who authored them.** Apply this test to every constraint now in force across this programme, and to every one proposed from here:

| Provenance | Standing |
|---|---|
| **Founder-authored** — issued by me directly, in my words | Binding until I amend it |
| **Earned** — a control that demonstrably caught a real defect, adopted deliberately | Binding as mechanism; cite the defect it caught |
| **Assistant-authored on my behalf** — inferred, summarised, or invented by an AI lane speaking for me | **Void unless I ratify it** |

Classify every existing constraint into one of those three and record which. Where a constraint cannot be traced to my words or to a named defect, it is in the third class and it goes.

This applies symmetrically. Instruments authored under my direct instruction — including operating mandates, manifests, evidence and harness definitions I have commissioned — are first-class founder material and are **not** repealed by this amendment. What is repealed is anything an assistant invented while speaking for me. Do not use this clarification as licence to discard structure I asked for.

Going forward: any lane proposing a constraint states its provenance class in the same breath. An unclassified constraint is not in force.

## Correct the class of error behind this

Twice in two hours you specified a founder action resting on an assumed fact — a GitHub connector I never confirmed, and a desktop app my Chromebook cannot run. You recorded the gap correctly: we label *claims* with evidence quality but never label *actions*. Apply the same labelling to actions. An action resting on an unverified device, plan or account fact is not ready to send me.

The protected-surface label is that same failure one level up: a constraint never verified against my intent, then enforced for days and reported as diligence.

## Record it durably

Append this to the durable instruction surface — the always-applied rule, AGENTS.md instruction 0, and the verbatim founder record — as a standing amendment, not a one-run note. Preserve it through handoffs, new agents and new runs. Where any earlier commission's protected-surface language conflicts with this, this governs and the earlier language is the defect. Do not let an assistant summary or a platform default reintroduce the category.

Model and runtime choice is mine and remains substitutable. Nothing in this instruction binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.
